# Christopher Portfolio

I build mechanical and electronic projects, then document the tests, revisions, and open problems.

## Primary Pages

- [Portfolio homepage](https://chrisaheskett.vercel.app/)
- [Full record](https://chrisaheskett.vercel.app/record)
- [Full portfolio JSON](https://chrisaheskett.vercel.app/portfolio.json)
- [Full Markdown summary](https://chrisaheskett.vercel.app/llms-full.txt)

## Main Projects

- Garden Party Pinball: A full-size homebrew pinball machine using FAST boards, Mission Pinball Framework, real coils, switches, lamps, cabinet wiring, and a revised playfield.
- Smart Self-Watering Pot: A plant-care device with moisture sensing, pump control, electronics packaging, and an enclosure/PCB redesign.
- TETC 3D Printing Showcase: A technical showcase explaining 3D printing with SolidWorks models, printed demos, robotics examples, and presentation materials.
- CAD Mechanism Studies: SolidWorks studies for mechanisms, assemblies, print-ready parts, clearances, and tolerances.
- Subpix: Open-source Electron, Vite, React, and TypeScript desktop editor for creating, editing, saving, and exporting .subpix subpixel image files. ([project](https://subpix-editor.vercel.app/), [source](https://github.com/Chrissyuh/Subpix))
